surface: Guest Chat when the platform refuses a request at its usage limit
title: HTTP 402 guest usage refusal appears as a generic retryable chat failure
reproduction: On the Store-installed 0.2.176 guest profile, two requests completed and a later new-chat send immediately showed generic service-error copy with Retry.

The corresponding live POST returned HTTP 402 while the guest's enforced usage state was over limit. Deployed aidream source maps UsageLimitReachedError for guest to the flat guest_ai_allowance_used error; audit logs did not retain this response body.

Published0.2.176 predates allowance-specific HTTP handling. Pending0.2.181 and pre-fix current-main source classify the exact structured guest code only at HTTP403; both miss the deployed402 contract.
expected: For the exact structured guest_ai_allowance_used refusal, both documented HTTP 402 and 403 forms show the fixed free-signup remedy without Retry; unrelated 402 and 403 responses retain their existing generic behavior. The usage limit remains enforced.
actual: The exact 0.2.205 Store ZIP candidate passed independent unpacked native acceptance: four real fresh-guest answers, a fifth live HTTP 402 guest_ai_allowance_used with the free-account remedy and no Retry, and a second live HTTP 402 after panel reload and New chat in the same exhausted guest profile. Published 0.2.176 still shows the generic retryable failure; actual Store-installed 0.2.205 is pending publication.
severity: S2: guest Chat misrepresents a usage refusal as a retryable service error
priority: P1: keep the client aligned with the deployed usage-refusal contract
